title: Arecibo Telescope
geometryBasis: Named mapped remains locate the reflector and three tower bases with their ground cable anchorages. Fit the 305 m optical circle to the surviving circular edge. Telescope orientation follows all three mapped footing positions.
sectionBasis: Use the 265.176 m surveyed curvature radius and 496.84 m center-of-curvature elevation. The published platform and cable-pin levels set the suspended and tower heights. The exact 2006 exterior documents the azimuth gear, trusses, dome and line feed.
limitations: The date range covers the intact 1997 upgrade through the period before Hurricane Maria damaged the original line feed. The 2006 reference fixes the appearance. The arm and dome are shown in one plausible operating position.

Exact tower cap elevations, slab and truss sections, reflector support spacing and cable sag remain approximate. Ground footings follow original Terrarium elevations. A bounded render opening hides overlapping coarse terrain within the historical reflector rim while preserving its underlying elevation samples.
